description: This file defines the CreateGroupCommandHandler class, a service component responsible for handling commands to create groups within the system. It processes create group commands, extracts relevant parameters, and delegates the creation logic to the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class annotated with @Service that implements NewCommandSourceHandler to process create group commands.

methods.name: CreateGroupCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a reference to GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the create group command by extracting the centerId parameter and delegating group creation to the service.
